title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades. title: Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program
description:
Overview

This is an international staff role based at our Headquarters in Washington, D.C. We offer visa and relocation support.

We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

The Amazonia Forever Unit has rapidly positioned itself as a strategic leader in advancing sustainable development across the Amazonia region. In just three years, it has mobilized over $4.2 billion in operations across eight countries, launched innovative financing mechanisms, including Indigenous-led funds. Coordinated the first loans under the Green Climate Fund and the Amazon Bioeconomy and Forest Management Fund. Through regional networks, knowledge platforms, and global partnerships, the Unit has strengthened institutional capacities, promoted inclusive growth, and elevated the IDB’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.

We are seeking a strategic leader to serve as Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program. This role is central to advancing sustainable and inclusive development across the Amazonia region, which is home to nearly 40% of South America’s landmass. The Unit Chief will lead cross-sectoral efforts, manage funding mechanisms, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure impactful and cohesive development strategies.

This position will report to the Manager of the Southern Cone Department. It will advise and support the Vice Presidency of Countries and Regional Integration, as well as the CSC, CAN, and CCB Managers, in the preparation, development, and implementation of national and regional dialogues, strategies, and activities related to the Amazonia Forever Program.

What you’ll do

As Unit Chief, you will lead and manage the Amazonia Forever Regional Program within the Bank and its funding mechanisms and coordinate the external partners and networks that are part of the Program.

Regional Dialogues & Country Engagement

  • Coordinate high-level dialogues across Amazonia-region countries, in close collaboration with Country Representatives, to identify shared priorities and build consensus around strategic development goals.
  • Align Amazonia Forever Program goals with Country Strategies, ensuring coherence across sectors and countries.
  • Engage diverse partners and stakeholders to shape initiatives within the Amazonia Forever Program.

Operational Strategy & Policy Development

  • Advise senior management on the formulation of operational strategies, policies, and guidelines tailored to the Amazonia region.
  • Promote implementation of the program’s five key pillars:
  • Combating deforestation and strengthening environmental control and security.
  • Bioeconomy and creative economy.
  • People-centered development.
  • Sustainable cities, infrastructure, and connectivity.
  • Sustainable, low-carbon agriculture, livestock, and forestry.
  • Integrate cross-cutting themes: inclusion of women, Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, and local communities; climate, biodiversity, and forest conservation; and institutional capacity and rule of law.

Financing And Resource Mobilization

  • Collaborate with the IDB Global Partnerships Department to mobilize resources from donors and partners.
  • Coordinate and manage various funding mechanisms, including donor resources and IDB’s own funds.
  • Leverage Amazonia Forever’s financial instruments to support strategic solutions for regional development challenges.

Stakeholder Engagement & Community Dialogues

  • Coordinate inclusive engagement with civil society, indigenous and Afro-descendant communities, and traditional Amazonian populations in collaboration with IDB Civil Society Unit.
  • Strengthening partnerships with national and international organizations, donors, and private sector actors.

Knowledge & Innovation Agenda

  • Lead the knowledge and innovation agenda of the Amazonia Forever Program, working in close coordination with the Southern Cone, Andean, and Caribbean Departments to ensure regional integration and strategic alignment.
  • Promote experimental programs and pioneering research to support sustainable development.
  • Oversee development and dissemination of knowledge products aligned with program priorities.

Institutional Partnerships & External Representation

  • Coordinate joint initiatives with IDB Invest and IDB Lab.
  • Ensure integration of cross-cutting themes such as climate resilience, sustainability, and social inclusion within IDB Group.
  • Represent the IDB in global forums and multilateral platforms to promote the Bank’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.
  • Build and strengthen partnerships with other MDBs, international agencies, and private sector actors to support coordinated regional efforts.

What you'll need

  • Education: You hold an advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) from an accredited university in a field of the social sciences or humanities that is relevant to sustainable and inclusive development.
  • Experience: Experience related to advancing sustainable and/or inclusive development in the region.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English, and Spanish or Portuguese.

Professional Experience

  • You have extensive experience conducting strategic-level technical dialogues with diverse groups (e.g. public sector, private sector, civil society, Indigenous and/or traditional communities), including dialogues in matters related to your work.
  • Experience facilitating dialogues and negotiations that directly involved more than one country is a plus.
  • You have experience in connecting strategic-level discussions with realities at the operational level.
  • A working understanding of multi-lateral development banks is advantageous.
  • You have demonstrated understanding of the fundamental economic, socio-cultural, and environmental characteristics of the Amazonian territories within the countries that are the focus of the Amazonia Forever Regional Program.

Requirements

  • Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Staff: International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What we offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package, including an annual base salary expressed on a net-of-tax basis.
  • Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.
  • Pension plan: a defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and supports employees in planning for their future.
  • We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.
  • Hybrid and flexible work schedules.
  • Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center, which provides preventive care and health education for employees.
  • Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

Sobre a Vaga

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável por atuar na administração de registros e documentos escolares. Terá a função de operacionalizar os processos de matrícula e transferência, de organização de turmas e de registros do histórico escolar dos estudantes.

Responsabilidades

O que você fará:

  • Coordenar e executar as tarefas decorrentes dos encargos da Secretaria;
  • Organizar e manter em dia o protocolo, o arquivo escolar e o registro de assentamento dos alunos, bem como a regularidade da vida escolar do aluno;
  • Verificar a autenticidade dos documentos escolares;
  • Organizar e manter em dia a coletânea de leis, regulamentos, diretrizes, portarias, circulares, resoluções e demais documentos;
  • Redigir a correspondência que lhe for confiada, lavrar atas e termos, nos livros próprios;
  • Rever todo o expediente a ser submetido ao despacho da Direção;
  • Apresentar à Direção, em tempo hábil, todos os documentos que devem ser assinados;
  • Zelar pelo uso adequado e conservação dos bens materiais distribuídos à Secretaria;
  • Manter sigilo sobre assuntos pertinentes ao serviço;
  • Responder ao Censo Escolar Anual.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de curso técnico em secretaria escolar ou Licenciatura Plena em Pedagogia;
  • Experiência prévia de pelo menos 1 ano na função;
  • Conhecimento das normas locais que dizem respeito à função;
  • Excel avançado (procv e outras habilidades para manter planilhas de controle atualizadas e poder cruzar listagens).

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Declaração de Salvaguarda

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences; to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors; partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner; reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity; cares holistically for those served; maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered; treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.

Minimum Requirements

  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.
  • Active DEA and Controlled Substance licenses and registrations.
  • Four (4) years of responsible work experience in psychiatry.
  • A great bedside manner and the ability to remain calm, empathetic and patient while interacting with patients who suffer from severe mental disorders.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Data Engineer - Remote, Latin America role at Bluelight

Bluelight Consulting is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone\'s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience with AWS services including but not limited to S3, Athena, EC2, EMR, and Glue.
  • Ability to solve any ongoing issues with operating the cluster.
  • Experience with the integration of data from multiple data sources.
  • Experience with various database technologies such as SQLServer, Redshift, Postgres, and RDS.
  • Experience with one or more of the following data integration platforms: Pentaho Kettle, SnapLogic, Talend OpenStudio, Jitterbit, Informatica PowerCenter, or similar.
  • Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always-up, always-available service.
  • Experience with or knowledge of Agile Software Development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with a keen sense of customer service.
  • Experience with collecting/managing/reporting on large data stores.
  • Awareness of Data governance and data quality principles.
  • Well-versed in Business Analytics including basic metric building and troubleshooting.
  • Understand Integration architecture: application integration and data flow diagrams, source-to-target mappings, data dictionary reports.
  • Familiar with Web Services: XML, REST, SOAP.
  • Experience with Git or similar version control software.
  • Experience with integrations with and/or use of BI tools such as GoodData (preferred), Tableau, PowerBI, or similar.
  • Broad experience with multiple RDBMS: MS SQLServer, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift.
  • Familiarity with SaaS/cloud data systems (e.g. Salesforce).
  • Data warehouse design: star-schemas, change data capture, denormalization.
  • SQL/DDL queries/Tuning techniques such as indexing, sorting, and distribution.
  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of Data Pipeline development such as SnapLogic or Datastage, Informatica, or related experience.
  • 3+ years of SQL experience (No-SQL experience is a plus).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines.

What You\'ll Be Doing

  • Develop and maintain data models for core package application and reporting databases to describe objects and fields for support documentation and to facilitate custom application development and data integration.
  • Monitoring execution and performance of daily pipelines, triage and escalate any issues.
  • Collaborates with analytics and business teams to improve data models and data pipelines that feed business intelligence tools, increasing data accessibility and fostering data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  • Implements processes and systems to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes.
  • Writes unit/integration tests, contributes to engineering wiki, and documents work.
  • Performs data analysis required to troubleshoot data-related issues and assist in the resolution of data issues.
  • Work within AWS/Linux cloud systems environment in support of data integration solution
  • Works closely with a team of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and analysts.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with team members. Share knowledge, provide visibility of interpersonal accomplishments and follow directions when provided.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Technology / Office stipend
  • Health Coverage
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

title: Oil Marketing Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description:
Oil Marketing Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to join the Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division of Crude Oil Sales & Marketing Dept (COSMD).

The Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division is responsible for providing oil market analysis, market intelligence and data analytics, strategic studies and market research, as well as project management and coordination within the crude oil sales and marketing department.

Your primary role is to oversee and manage various marketing activities, drive marketing research initiatives, and optimize performance to support the company’s overall marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide expertise in a specialized area with crude oil placement strategy and market analysis.
  • Participate in analysis and strategy development that addresses short- and long-term needs, highly complex issues and challenges.
  • Mentor, train, and develop others to provide awareness of the complex concepts within crude oil markets.
  • Undertake complex studies within your developed area of expertise in crude oil placement strategy and market analysis that can impact the company’s present and future operations.
  • Monitor the development of existing and emerging market trends to forecast their viability and evolution over time.
  • Frequently direct and/or coordinate work task forces on special studies and consult directly with Executive Management on issues as they arise.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance on complex planning and analysis problems to senior planning and analytical personnel and to Executive Management.
  • Collaborate with partners and key internal and external stakeholders on low carbon value proposition, presentation of analytical results as well as support in establishing an organization focused on low carbon product.
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative analysis to support the areas of commercializing low carbon crude oil and low carbon products such as LCAF, SAF, Naphtha and others with focus on offsetting and carbon markets mechanisms.
  • Prepare and present plans, analyses, interpretations, conclusions and recommendations to Management and others on a broad range of petroleum market issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Science or equivalent from a recognized and approved program.
  • Advanced degree in economics, energy, or MBA is preferred.
  • Over 12 years of experience in oil and gas sustainability, Environment, Social & Governance (ESG) and carbon market industry.
  • Knowledge of carbon markets and environmental regulations related to GHG Emissions with understanding of the compliance carbon markets, voluntary carbon markets, baseline and crediting mechanisms, carbon-related trade measures and carbon pricing.
  • Extensive knowledge of global crude oil market balances and flows; pricing dynamics and structures; and methodologies of reporting agencies and exchange contracts.
  • Familiarity with refinery and petrochemicals, linear programming, and investment financial modeling is preferred.
  • Understanding of refining and refining economics.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from qualified candidates.

Join to apply for the Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional) role at tl;dv - AI Meeting Assistant.

Overview

We are building a differentiated brand in a competitive AI/SaaS market. This is a part-time freelance role with a clear path to a full-time position within 12 months based on impact. You will report to the Founder/Marketing/Head of Design and work with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to ship work that moves metrics.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and strategic restraint where it matters.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you have references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold; you can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with; low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elemento power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in up to 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal → your role → outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

title: Data Engineer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Overview

This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Data Engineer in Latin America. As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines and integration solutions that power critical business decisions. You will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, supporting cross-functional teams by ensuring data is accurate, accessible, and optimized for analysis. Your contributions will directly impact the efficiency and reliability of data-driven processes, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions. This role provides the opportunity to work with modern cloud platforms, large-scale databases, and business intelligence tools, while continuously improving data quality, performance, and accessibility across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines and integration workflows to support analytics and business intelligence needs
  • Design and maintain data models, ensuring accurate documentation of objects, fields, and relationships
  • Monitor data pipeline execution and performance, triaging and escalating issues as necessary
  • Collaborate with analytics, product, and engineering teams to improve data models, pipeline efficiency, and data accessibility
  • Implement processes for data quality monitoring and validation to ensure reliable production data
  • Perform data analysis to troubleshoot and resolve issues, supporting accurate reporting and decision-making
  • Document processes, contribute to engineering wikis, and write unit/integration tests to maintain system reliability
  • Work within cloud environments (AWS/Linux) and integrate with diverse data sources and platforms

Qualifications

  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 3+ years of experience in data pipeline development using tools such as SnapLogic, Datastage, Informatica, or equivalent
  • 3+ years of SQL experience; familiarity with NoSQL databases is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services including S3, Athena, EC2, EMR, and Glue
  • Experience with database technologies such as SQLServer, Redshift, Postgres, RDS, and multiple RDBMS systems
  • Familiarity with data warehouse design, including star schemas, denormalization, and change data capture
  • Experience with data integration platforms and ETL best practices
  • Knowledge of Agile software development methodologies and IT operations for highly available services
  • Familiarity with Web Services (REST, SOAP, XML) and cloud/SaaS data systems (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, PowerBI, or GoodData
  • Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills with a customer-focused mindset

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible working hours and remote work opportunities
  • Generous paid-time-off policy and national holidays
  • Health coverage and wellness benefits
  • Technology/office stipend and continuing education support (training, courses, certifications, conferences)
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment with opportunities for mentorship and career growth
  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects and modern technologies that accelerate professional development

O que é a nstech?
A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Acreditamos no poder da tecnologia para melhorar o mundo, reduzindo a emissão de CO2, acidentes e roubos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Business Intelligence no time de Product Marketing. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

  • Sólida habilidade em análise de dados, métricas e indicadores de negócio;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI) para criação de dashboards e relatórios;
  • Habilidade em storytelling com dados, transformando insights em recomendações claras para Product Managers e liderança;
  • Experiência prévia com HubSpot ou outro CRM;
  • Conhecimento em SQL ou outra linguagem de consulta a banco de dados;
  • Boa capacidade de organização e priorização de informações para diferentes stakehold.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com estudos de mercado (TAM, SAM, SOM);
  • Conhecimento em segmentação de clientes e análise de comportamento de usuários;
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de análise de dados ou linguagens como Python/R;
  • Vivência em Revenue Operations (RevOps).

O que esperamos de você:
Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos pilares culturais e seus atributos são:

  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados

Por que trabalhar na nstech?
Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

title: Scaled Customer Manager - On Demand
description:
Company Overview
Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do
As the Scaled Customer Manager, you are an extension of the Customer Success Account Management (CSAM) team that oversees an incoming queue of requests. Their primary function is to connect customers with the right resources, ensuring an outstanding customer experience as measured by NPS, net revenue retention, referrals, and product usage indicators. The Scaled Customer Manager performs just-in-time tactical account management activities. They will collaborate with other team members to coordinate successful customer engagement, product enablement, and demonstrate value across the entire customer journey.

This position is an individual contributor reporting to the Manager, Scaled Customer Management.

Responsibility

  • Monitor and manage a high volume of customer inquiries through digital channels
  • Triage requests by routing to the appropriate internal teams or providing self-service content; escalate patterns or systemic issues as needed
  • Create and assign Call To Actions (CTAs) to On-Demand 1:1 Specialists or other internal stakeholders
  • Respond to customers with clear, friendly, and accurate email communication that addresses immediate needs and encourages 1:1 engagement when appropriate
  • Track and document engagement outcomes in Salesforce or Gainsight
  • Maintain and contribute to a response library and create reusable content for recurring inquiries
  • Collaborate with Digital and On Demand SCMs, Support, Product, and CS teams to ensure aligned messaging and coordinated engagement
  • Support KPIs related to CSAT, retention, and resolution time through effective queue management and triage execution
  • Continuously develop product knowledge to guide customers effectively and contribute to scalable digital workflows
  • Identify insights and opportunities from customer interactions to inform proactive strategies and improve team processes
  • Maintain accountability for your digital queue, executing tasks with accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail

Job Designation
Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring
Basic

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, preferably in Customer Success, Support, or Account Management
  • Experience managing high volumes of customer inquiries via digital channels such as email, web forms, or CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight)
  • Experience documenting and tracking customer interactions and outcomes in CRM or engagement platforms
  • Experience identifying patterns in customer feedback and escalating issues appropriately
Preferred
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to craft clear, professional, and customer-friendly responses
  • Ability to triage customer needs effectively by routing to internal resources or providing relevant self-help content
  • Demonstrated ability to identify trends from customer inquiries and contribute to content development or response libraries
  • Experience creating or maintaining self-service resources, knowledge base articles, or email response templates
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle stages and how to drive adoption through digital touchpoints
  • Proven ability to collaborate across functions (e.g., Product, Marketing, Support, Sales) to align on messaging and resolve customer needs
  • Strong attention to detail with experience managing multiple tasks or workflows in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly organized and able to manage a digital task queue with accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail
  • Comfortable collaborating across teams, including Customer Success, Product, Support, and Sales, to ensure aligned messaging and support
  • Proactive, adaptable, and able to contribute to process improvements in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Willingness to continuously build product knowledge to support effective customer guidance and triage decisions

Life at Docusign
Working here
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes;
  • Reportar e dar feedback a Sany periodicamente sobre todas as falhas e trabalhos realizados;
  • Concluir as orientações técnica e outros trabalhos emitidos pelo departamento comercial ou conforme necessidade da Sany;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com clientes, representantes e colaboradores;
  • Elaborar relatório de Diagnóstico de falhas.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ter concluído o ensino técnico em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou áreas afins;
  • Ter experiência com manutenção em Guindastes.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Vale Refeição
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Commission Analyst
description:
Overview

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking a Commissions Analyst to ensure accuracy, responsiveness, and scalability in how commissions and revenue operations are managed in a dynamic, high-growth environment with multiple commission plans, frequent changes, and evolving billing needs.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a meticulous eye for detail, and is energized by building efficient processes that reduce risk and improve visibility. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver timely and accurate commissions, resolve system issues, and implement process improvements that scale with the business. This role is critical to ensuring commissions are paid correctly and on time, while also strengthening revenue recognition and reporting processes.

Responsibilities

  • Accurate and reliable commissions: Ensure commission processes are managed with precision, supporting timely and error-free payouts that build trust across the sales organization.
  • Clear visibility into revenue operations: Strengthen reporting and data integrity in Spiff, Salesforce, and billing systems, enabling leadership to make confident, data-driven decisions.
  • Proactive issue resolution: Help surface and address discrepancies in opportunities, contracts, or commission data early, minimizing downstream risks and delays.
  • Scalable processes and automation: Contribute to the design of workflows and reporting that reduce manual effort, improve transparency, and adapt as the business grows.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Build strong relationships with Sales, Finance, and Operations by serving as a reliable partner and trusted resource on commissions and revenue reporting.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, commissions administration, or related finance roles, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth environment.
  • Strong technical proficiency with commissions tools (Spiff preferred), Salesforce CRM, and billing/AR platforms, with the ability to implement changes and troubleshoot independently.
  • Background in accounting operations (billing, invoicing, AR, or contract review) that strengthens commission accuracy and revenue reporting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, paired with an ownership mindset and ability to manage 3–4 concurrent projects without delays.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in reconciliations, variance analysis, and supporting ASC 340-40 compliance.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who provides fast, reliable support to cross-functional stakeholders.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full-time employees. TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work-life balance, we encourage you to ask about balance within teams and reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.

The Stakes Are Real: Our work has direct, real-world impact, including supporting urgent government requests, terrorist financing investigations, and global security efforts. We also build new processes quickly to stop criminals before they cash out and analyze blockchain data to recover stolen savings.

Life at TRM

As a remote-first company, TRM is built for global collaboration. We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication and meaningful relationships, invest in offsites and onboarding buddies, and prioritize trust and belonging.

Join our mission. We\'re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. If you’re excited about TRM\'s mission, we want to hear from you. TRM is remote-first, with a globally distributed team.

Recruitment agencies: TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. TRM Labs is not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes without a signed agreement. Privacy Policy: By submitting your application, you are agreeing to allow TRM to process your personal information in accordance with the TRM Privacy Policy.

description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone\'s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Here’s What You’ll Get To Work On:

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration:Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Here’s the experience we’re looking for:

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Here’s what we’re looking for this role to achieve:

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Planejamento de Sistemas OSS/NMS, com sólida experiência em gestão ágil de projetos de OSS/TI, controle e gestão de orçamentos e elaboração de documentos técnicos e estratégicos para contratação de soluções e serviços (RFPs, RFIs, especificações técnicas). Você fará parte de uma equipe responsável pelo planejamento, integração e evolução das plataformas de gestão e monitoramento de rede da V.tal, garantindo que as soluções OSS/NMS atendam aos requisitos operacionais, de desempenho e de integração com múltiplos domínios tecnológicos. Sua atuação será estratégica, envolvendo desde a concepção de novos projetos até a avaliação de propostas técnicas, integração de sistemas, gestão de fornecedores e acompanhamento de cronogramas e orçamentos. Diferenciais incluem conhecimentos gerais em telecomunicações, abrangendo diferentes tecnologias (DWDM, GPON, IP/MPLS, etc.), integração sistêmica (REST, Kafka) e atuação em ambientes DevOps / CI/CD.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e coordenar projetos de implantação e evolução de plataformas OSS/NMS, aplicando metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e melhores práticas de gestão de projetos;
  • Elaborar, revisar e analisar RFPs, RFIs e especificações técnicas para contratação de soluções e serviços de OSS/TI;
  • Controlar orçamentos e custos de projetos, assegurando a execução conforme o planejado;
  • Realizar avaliação técnica de propostas de fornecedores, garantindo alinhamento com requisitos funcionais, não funcionais e de integração;
  • Participar do desenho e acompanhamento da arquitetura de integração de sistemas, incluindo interfaces REST, mensageria (Kafka) e outros padrões;
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas de Operação, Engenharia, Segurança e fornecedores para definição de soluções técnicas;
  • Desenvolver e manter documentação técnica, manuais e guias de boas práticas para sistemas OSS/NMS;
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas para evolução contínua das plataformas de gestão de rede.

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnólogo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada (mínimo de 5 anos) em planejamento, análise e implantação de soluções OSS/NMS;
  • Atuação prévia em gestão de projetos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) aplicados a ambientes de OSS/TI;
  • Experiência em elaboração e análise de RFPs, RFIs, especificações técnicas e documentos de contratação;
  • Experiência em gestão e controle de orçamentos de projetos;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em arquiteturas de integração de sistemas (REST, Kafka, SOAP, etc.);
  • Habilidade para comunicação técnica estruturada e elaboração de relatórios executivos;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes multidisciplinares e interagir com diversas áreas da empresa e fornecedores. Conhecimentos gerais de redes e telecomunicações em múltiplos domínios (DWDM, GPON, IP/MPLS, 4G/5G);
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevOps / CI/CD;
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, SAFe);
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Previdência Privada
  • Programa de participação nos resultados (PPR)
  • Auxílio creche
  • Flexibilidade de horário
  • Licença maternidade estendida (6 meses)
  • Licença paternidade estendida (20 dias)

Sobre a V.tal

Nós somos a V.tal, uma empresa que nasceu com o propósito de viabilizar a conexão com o mundo digital transformando a vida das pessoas. Trabalhamos para incluir o Brasil no topo da lista dos países mais digitalizados do mundo, promovendo a inclusão digital, impulsionando novos negócios e estimulando o desenvolvimento regional.

title: Visual Designer Strategist (Social Media)
description:
Visual Designer Strategist (Social Media)

Overview

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritise creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About the team

Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.

Responsibilities

We’re looking for a Motion Designer (Visual Designer Strategist) to join our Brand & Content team. This role is focused on designing and producing motion graphics , product animations , short- and long-form social content , GIFs , and more—all that capture attention, reflect our brand, and drive engagement across Teachable’s social platforms.

This is an individual contributor role (not a management role). You’ll collaborate closely with designers, copywriters, product marketers, and social media managers to transform ideas into visually compelling content—ranging from product animations that highlight key features to video series that spotlight creator success stories. Your work will play a key role in how creators discover, understand, and connect with Teachable.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and produce motion graphics, product demos, product feature animations, social animations, GIFs, and short-form video assets for Teachable’s social channels.
  • Translate static creative concepts into engaging motion content that supports campaigns, launches, product storytelling, and evergreen social content.
  • Collaborate with the social media manager and brand designer to ensure content aligns with Teachable’s visual identity and social strategy.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.
  • Stay current on motion design, animation, and social media trends to keep our content fresh and innovative.
  • Optimize creative for different platforms (Instagram, YouTube + YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, etc.).

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional experience in motion design, with a strong portfolio showcasing social-first content and product-focused animations.
  • Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva , and other relevant design tools.
  • Expertise in creating short-form animations, product walkthroughs, motion graphics, and GIFs for social media.
  • Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in SaaS, edtech, or within the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
  • Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and social media.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations.

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we\'re committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

Note

Teachable is a remote-first company with occasional in-person events.

EEO notice

Teachable is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Business Analyst role at Tort Experts

About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve. If you’re looking for a workplace where your contributions can truly make a difference, and where innovation meets purpose, Tort Experts is the perfect place for you.

About The Role

We are hiring a Business Analyst to strengthen our Client Services team by owning reporting, reconciliation, and proactive analysis across client accounts. This role ensures accuracy in case counts and budgets, surfaces performance insights, and creates scalable reporting solutions that empower the entire team.

The ideal candidate is mid-level, highly analytical, and able to take full ownership of results with minimal oversight. They are adept at spotting trends, building actionable reports, and anticipating issues before they become problems. Over time, this role may evolve into a companywide business analyst position, with broader responsibility for insights and reporting across teams.

Location: Remote (must be available 9am - 5p ET)

What You'll Do

Client Reporting & Reconciliation

  • Case Data Reconciliation: Own the process of reconciling signed case counts between internal systems and client reports, resolving discrepancies independently.
  • Fund Reallocations: Accurately process client requests to move budgets across projects, ensuring all updates are reflected in reporting.
  • Custom Reporting: Deliver accurate, client-ready reports that align with goals and expectations, while continuously improving report templates and workflows.

Proactive Analysis & Insights

  • Issue Detection: Monitor conversion rates, lead quality, and profitability by lead type and field values to proactively spot risks and opportunities.
  • Performance Analysis: Provide insights into client and campaign profitability, pricing effectiveness, and lead monetization trends.
  • Self-Serve Reporting: Build dashboards and recurring reports that give team members visibility into critical KPIs without requiring manual analysis each time.
  • Scalable Insights: Develop frameworks for analyzing trends that can be reused across clients and campaigns.

Operational Excellence & Financial Control

  • Accuracy Safeguarding: Ensure all reconciliations, reallocations, and reports are error-free and backed by clear data sources.
  • Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in reporting and reconciliation, and create scalable solutions that save time and reduce errors.
  • Collaboration: Support the Director of Client Services by taking on data-heavy work, freeing leadership to focus on strategy and client growth.

Client-Facing Support

  • Email Communication: Participate in client email threads to share reconciled numbers, reporting deliverables, and updates related to reallocations.
  • Light Client Interaction: Join occasional client calls to clarify data, while leaving strategic discussions to the Director of Client Services.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in business analysis, reporting, client operations, or related analytical roles. Experience in legal case acquisition or performance marketing is a plus.
  • Technical Skills: Master level of proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas) and reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to slice/dice data, reconcile discrepancies, and extract actionable insights across multiple variables (lead type, conversion rates, profitability, etc.).
  • Automation & Tools: Comfortable building repeatable reports, dashboards, and using AI or automation to accelerate data comparison and analysis.
  • Ownership: Able to take responsibility for results with little oversight, quickly becoming the go-to person for reporting and analysis.
  • Communication: Clear, concise written skills for client-facing updates and internal reports.
  • Adaptability: Ability to learn new systems quickly and thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift rapidly.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Extremely detail-oriented and accuracy-obsessed.
    • High ownership, proactive problem-solver who identifies issues before others see them.
    • Curious and driven to dig into data until key insights emerge.
    • Comfortable in a support role, enabling leadership to focus on higher-level strategy.
    • Growth-oriented, eager to expand from client-level reporting into companywide business analysis.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance
  • 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):
    • medical (Aetna)
    • dental (Guardian)
    • vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution
  • 401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
  • Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
  • Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation.
